name: bLockerman's Minesweeper
desc:
Game made by bLockerman666 and aamo_s.

You can customize the board in private servers! (Note that wins don't count in them)
If you don't want to beat the tutorial, you can either skip it temporarily or play in a private server.
Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

scripts.features:
quite simple autosolver script tested on xeno & delta (works on both)

have in mind that script is heavily rage mode based, legit just exist and makes alot of mistakes

features:

rage mode
status - shows current status of the script and acts as a turn on button

toggle freeze (basically locks your character in place so you can't misstep on a mine)
toggle auto guess (automatically tries to predict where the mine could be if there is no solvation)
action delay (tp cooldown, self explanatory)
spawn delay (changes the time script would wait after you die in any way)

legit mode
status - same thing as in rage

auto flag (flags mines in range, kinda buggy)
calculate delay (amount of time before the script would calculate again)
flag range

event

collect presents - automatically collects presents if they spawn

made by @deadshizik

scripts.title: (PATCHED) MINESWEEPER SERVER TROLL! (Auto Solver)
scripts.script:
_G.Enabled = true
function Split(s, delimiter)
result = {};
for match in (s..delimiter):gmatch("(.-)"..delimiter) do
table.insert(result, match);
end
return result;
end
spawn(function()
while true do
wait(5)
if _G.Enabled then
local start = Vector3.new(41.5, 56.5, 71.5)
for i,tile in pairs(game.Workspace.MS.Parts:GetChildren()) do
local posx = (tile.Position.X - start.x) / 5
local posz = (tile.Position.Z - start.Z) / 5
tile.Name = tostring(posx) .. "|" .. tostring(posz)
end
else
break
end
end
end)
while true do
wait(0.3)
if _G.Enabled then
if game.Workspace.MS.Parts:FindFirstChild("0|0") then
pcall(function() -- to spare you some time
local numbertiles = {}
for i,tile in pairs(game.Workspace.MS.Parts:GetChildren()) do
if tile.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Daisy orange") then
table.insert(numbertiles, tile)
end
end
for i,tile in pairs(numbertiles) do
local tilepos = Split(tile.Name, "|")
local tilex = tonumber(tilepos[1])
local tilez = tonumber(tilepos[2])
local totalnearbybombs = 0
local totalpossiblebombs = 0
local safetiles = {}
for x=-1, 1, 1 do
for z=-1, 1, 1 do
if game.Workspace.MS.Parts:FindFirstChild(tostring(tilex + x) .. "|" .. tostring(tilez + z)) then
local nearbytile = game.Workspace.MS.Parts[tostring(tilex + x) .. "|" .. tostring(tilez + z)]
if nearbytile.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Really red") then
totalpossiblebombs = totalpossiblebombs + 1
totalnearbybombs = totalnearbybombs + 1
end
if nearbytile.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Moss") or nearbytile.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Shamrock") then
totalpossiblebombs = totalpossiblebombs + 1
table.insert(safetiles, nearbytile)
end
end
end
end
--print(tile.Name, tonumber(tile.SurfaceGui.TextLabel.Text), totalnearbybombs, totalpossiblebombs)
if totalnearbybombs == tonumber(tile.SurfaceGui.TextLabel.Text) then
for i,stile in pairs(safetiles) do
if stile.Color ~= Color3.new(0, 1, 0) then
-- auto fire interests


local head = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Head
stile.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)

firetouchinterest(head, stile, 0)

wait(0.1)

firetouchinterest(head, stile, 1)
end
end
elseif totalpossiblebombs == tonumber(tile.SurfaceGui.TextLabel.Text) then
for i,stile in pairs(safetiles) do
if stile:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") then
stile.TouchInterest:Destroy()
end
if stile.Color ~= Color3.new(1, 0, 0) then
stile.Color = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
end
end
end
end
end)
end
else
break
end
end
